name: Shinjin Kantoku to Shojo Joyuu
source: The protagonist is a new adult video director who wishes to make his first porn movie. After years of working in the AV industry as a behind the scenes staff, he finally has the opportunity to became a director himself. Monono Hasumi is the actress selected by the owner of the AV studio to work with the protagonist in his debut movie. Monono is a virgin, but because she is short on money, she agrees to do any scene in the AV with no restrictions.
